messages:
sam: Quick preflight check — change window tonight 00:00-02:00 PT. Need final go/no-go and all pins by 21:30 PT. Any objections?
lee: Ack. Planning staggered canary: 5% -> 25% over 30m, smoke + perf after each step. Tagging @sre-oncall to confirm infra headroom. :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: Confirmed. Cluster capacity looks fine for the window, ~30% spare GPU headroom in us-west clusters. Will watch autoscaler and queue length.
rachel: Docs/metrics embargo? We should hold publish of release notes until 02:10 PT to avoid false positives in today's dashboards.
maya: Please pin runtime and model versions for the duration. I'll pin model artifact `model-redwood-v2.7.1-quant` to dedicated pool and keep a warm fallback (v2.7.0) pinned too.
sam: Rollback criteria proposal: immediate rollback if any of the following within 15m of rollout: (1) error rate > 2x baseline for 5m, (2) p95 latency increase > 30% sustained for 5m, (3) failed end-to-end smoke. Agree?
lee: Agree. Add automated rollback on deploy-bot if smoke fails. I'll instrument a quick eval set as part of the canary job.
rachel: FYI: marketing is expecting the feature toggle flip no earlier than 02:15 PT. We'll coordinate after you call it green.
maya: Pin command I'm going to run (copying for audit):
```
rbctl pin artifact model-redwood-v2.7.1-quant --pool=dedicated-us-west --until=2026-03-21T04:00:00Z --note="preflight pin for 00:00 window"
rbctl pin artifact model-redwood-v2.7.0 --pool=dedicated-us-west --note="fallback"
```
lee: I'll start canary config in deploy job and wire smoke: `scripts/smoke_canary.sh --evalset=nightly-critical --timeout=300s`
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy v2.7.1 -> prod. Window: 2026-03-21T00:00:00Z - 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z. Canary steps: 5%, 25%. Auto-rollback: enabled. (deploy id: db-216789-needle)
sam: Approval: @lee, @maya, @sre-oncall — please react with :thumbsup: by 21:30 PT if all good.
lee: :thumbsup:
maya: :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: :thumbsup: 
sam: Copy that — proceeding to lock quiet window at 21:31 PT. Reminder: no unrelated infra changes during the window, and oncall must not accept non-urgent alerts escalation unless it's a hard outage.
lee: Starting canary at 00:00 PT; will post smoke/pass results in this thread.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: db-216789-needle -> canary(5%).
lee: Canary smoke (5%) — PASS. Latency and errors within baseline. Rolling to 25% now.
deploy-bot: Canary step complete: 25% -> observations: p95 latency +4%, error rate +1%. Proceeding to finish rollout.
lee: Full rollout complete. Post-rollout smoke: PASS.
sre-oncall: Monitoring for 20m post-rollout. No anomalies in metrics, alerting thresholds stable.
sam: Great work team. Keeping change freeze until 02:15 PT per doc embargo. Will unfreeze after marketing publish and a final thumbs up from SRE.
rachel: Marketing confirmed publish at 02:10 PT.
sre-oncall: Final: :thumbsup: all clear at 02:12 PT, lifting embargo and freeze at 02:15 PT.
sam: Closing thread — release v2.7.1 green, pins in place, fallback ready. Thanks everyone. :tada:
